description.value: Fred's is a modern Italian kitchen owned by Catalog Hospitality, serving handmade pasta, wood-fired-style pizzas, and Italian small plates across three BC locations — Ambleside in West Vancouver, Sechelt, and Kitsilano. The Ambleside location offers private dining for groups up to 48 seated and features an exclusive wine list alongside a thoughtful cocktail program. Cyclists riding the North Shore waterfront corridor will find it a well-positioned sit-down meal stop in the Ambleside village.
